description: The declared corpus set. The runner asserts the directories it discovers against this list, so a corpus landed without a manifest — or a manifest landed without being declared — is a failure rather than an absence the runner reports as clean. Discovery alone cannot detect what was never added.
planned_note: Specified in CORPUS-v1-PLAN.md §2 and §3. A planned corpus that does not yet exist is expected and passes; a planned corpus that EXISTS must carry an EXPECTATIONS.json and move to `built`. `bytes-platform` and `instruments` MOVED TO BUILT at M3 batch N1E, in the same commit as their directories — ADR-0031 decision 2's N3-start freeze, asserted against `gatebraid/coverage-report@1`. `state-pipeline` remains planned and is NOT under-determined by oversight: its thirteen items assert O0 tool outcomes against a snapshot-document schema that does not exist, and ADR-0031 decision 2 freezes them at O0's start, against the schema O0 defines as its own first deliverable. DETERMINACY-REPORT.md is the single home of the item-by-item classification, its falsification case and the counts; this note deliberately does not restate them, because an enumeration copied here is a second home that drifts (ADR-0018 §3; ADR-0029 decision 3's rationale) — and in an earlier batch's first draft it did drift. ONE §6 item is frozen in NEITHER place: IN-01, re-assigned by the N1E correct-course to corpus v2 at P's start, for the reason recorded in fixtures/instruments/EXPECTATIONS.json's known_limitation.
